paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of four different audio-language models – Gwen2-Audio-Instructor, Audio2-Reasoner, Gwen2-Omni, and MMAR – when evaluated on the MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR datasets. The horizontal axis displays the model names, arranged alphabetically from left to right, while the vertical axis represents accuracy percentages, ranging from 20% to 69%, with values marked every 10% along a linear scale. The bars correspond to each model; a blue bar represents performance on the MMAU dataset, with a height of approximately 55% for Gwen2-Audio-Instructor, 52% for MMAR, 50% for Gwen2-Omni, and 38% for Audio2-Reasoner. A purple bar represents performance on the MMAR dataset, with a height of approximately 58% for Gwen2-Audio-Instructor, 53% for MMAR, 49% for Gwen2-Omni, and 32% for Audio2-Reasoner. All bars are presented in a regular, unsorted manner, and no bars are visually emphasized.
